body:
Thanks for sending an issue! Please fill in the following template to help quickly solve your problem.

### Describe the current behavior / 问题描述 (Mandatory / 必填)
            
mc2/moe_distribute_dispatch_v2/example/test_aclnn_moe_distribute_dispatch_v2.cpp中：
std::vector<int64_t> tpRecvCountsShape{TP_WORLD_SIZE * localExpertNum};

当设置tp_world_size = 1, 且localExpertNum > 1时，会导致tpRecvCountsShape = localExpertNum

应该修改为：
std::vector<int64_t> tpRecvCountsShape{TP_WORLD_SIZE};
### Environment / 环境信息 (Mandatory / 必填)
            
910C， Ascend-cann-toolkit_8.3.RC1_linux-x86_64
### Steps to reproduce the issue / 重现步骤 (Mandatory / 必填)
            
设置moe_expert_num = 32，ep_world_size = 16， tp_world_size = 1

然后测试dispatch_v2算子，会复现错误
![4ac183afbe0982fdf037a9a05af743db.png](https://raw.gitcode.com/user-images/assets/7673863/fdf42b71-6353-42fb-a011-d9f022299f76/4ac183afbe0982fdf037a9a05af743db.png '4ac183afbe0982fdf037a9a05af743db.png')
### Describe the expected behavior / 预期结果 (Mandatory / 必填)
            
无运行时报错
### Related log / screenshot / 日志 / 截图 (Mandatory / 必填)
            
![4ac183afbe0982fdf037a9a05af743db.png](https://raw.gitcode.com/user-images/assets/7673863/fde54748-2c84-4523-8069-54a7ca3d038b/4ac183afbe0982fdf037a9a05af743db.png '4ac183afbe0982fdf037a9a05af743db.png')
![c57cfef169069c56d3d0e5dc12db1a7a.jpg](https://raw.gitcode.com/user-images/assets/7673863/10076532-2608-47a9-8708-f143e9f64ba6/c57cfef169069c56d3d0e5dc12db1a7a.jpg 'c57cfef169069c56d3d0e5dc12db1a7a.jpg')
